title: Insufferable 22-Year-Old Assaults Security Guard Then Acts Like He’s The Victim
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 5th, 2023. Officers were conducting an investigation in the area when they started hearing people fighting inside the bar. They entered and separated the two, one was identified as a 22-year-old and the other was a security guard that works for the bar. The “frat” boy kept pleading his case and saying he didn’t do anything and said the security guard instigated the whole thing & that he punched him first. The security guard & the bartender who was a witness said that, the bar was closing and they asked the frat boy to leave however he became combative and when they tried to budge him to leave, he punched the security guard & then he grabbed a beer bottle and hit the security guard in the head, which started the whole fight. The security was a little shaken up however he  refused to press charges. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
